original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Exact admissible label-split region for the inherited mixed-negative Q8 necessary conditions, plus the block rank floor n_g >= t_g and the boundary equality ranks. No word is constructed or excluded.
scope_change_reason: The card's three-register obstruction is not changed; this is a necessary-condition refinement inside the same formal register model, chosen because it narrows the label splits of the still-open ten-call four-target questions left by PR3570/PR3578/PR3589. A search for a seven-call word in this model was abandoned after checking that PR3536 with the retained PR3471 exclusion already settles that value at nine; the stale open question in research/q8-min-length-census is recorded instead of re-derived.
bottleneck_link: Mathematical side result for the nonabelian bit register model. It bounds formal paid-call splits only; it does not improve the binding complex supplier or the selected kappa.
stop_rule: One exact region computation with the rank floor, its ten-call consequences for the open t = 4 shapes, and the boundary equality statement. No word search beyond the ten-call split list, no solver, no physical invoice.
evidence: PROOF.md, README.md, RESULT.json and verify.py; 90 exactly computed endpoint shapes, the ten-call split lists for every open t = 4 shape, a finite lattice check of the boundary equality ranks and an explicit F2 rank fixture; test_package.py behavioural controls.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Does a ten-call balanced (2,2) word exist at the (2,8) split?
open_questions.why_it_matters: PR3589 leaves the balanced four-target length ten undecided; the split list and the forced injective rank-two minority block are the smallest remaining target.
open_questions.first_step: Search over two independent i-calls and eight j-calls with rank(X_i) = rank(Y_i) = 2, exploiting the forced injectivity.
open_questions.blocked_by: A complete eight-call multiset enumeration at four roles is far beyond the bounded budget used here.

open_questions.question: Can the two tight orientations be satisfied simultaneously by a word?
open_questions.why_it_matters: At (2,8) the i-label is rank-tight while the j-label is not; a simultaneous tightness statement would exclude the split outright.
open_questions.first_step: Combine the boundary rank identity with PR3589's cubic correction rank X C Y for the same word.
open_questions.blocked_by: No simultaneous criterion was derived here.

open_questions.question: What is the sharp uniform constant for t >= 3?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The region minimum and the delivered minima already differ at three targets, so no purely rank-based constant is sharp.
open_questions.first_step: Compare the region minimum with the delivered minimum for every shape whose minimum is known.
open_questions.blocked_by: Only t <= 3 minima are delivered; t = 4 remains in {10,12}.

open_questions.question: Can a formal saving meet an actual caller allowance?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Formal paid labels do not price physical consumption.
open_questions.first_step: Bind an actual word to a physical layout, source ownership and a complete invoice.
open_questions.blocked_by: Scalar, routing, restoration, hosting, precision, recursive and supplier admission costs remain open.
